name: tw-cli public source delivery
inclusionPolicy: Explicit reviewed path allowlist in scripts/source-release-files.json. Directory walks never include additional files.
fixturePolicy: Fixtures are generated from test/helpers/demo-project.js or other synthetic source helpers at test time. No Scratch project archives are included.
platformAcceptance: macOS arm64 tested only; Windows/Linux installation not accepted
instructions: Install locked dependencies on Node24. Native project editing tests and tutorial:smoke are self-contained. Full development oracle tests require the documented frozen desktop source; browser/device/platform acceptance remains separate.

upstream/desktop-baseline-source.zip.note: Filtered upstream code archive; excluded sample Scratch projects are not redistributed. Original archive checksum is provenance, not the filtered archive checksum.

upstream/extensions-source.zip.note: Filtered upstream code archive; excluded sample Scratch projects are not redistributed. Original archive checksum is provenance, not the filtered archive checksum.
